scope: Certified finite-time capped paired-boundary parametrix, with full analytic collar functions, all auxiliary excursions and thermal windings. Actual-disk interior and propagation/comparison remain unbounded.
ordinary_argument_review: The boundary parametrix uses the actual analytic seam germ and its true C2,1 reflection. Auxiliary caps justify the local path representation only; no global disk transfer is inferred.
All metric and time derivatives are taken before selecting crossing paths that stay within the collar. No event indicator is differentiated.
A complex Picard contraction and explicit Cauchy tails certify full functions on the collar; the degree-64 polynomial is not substituted for the metric.
The fixed-z observation shift, density factor, connection vertex and both square partners are retained. The original time normalization supplies sqrt(beta), not an altered tolerance.
Positive pathwise polynomial bounds, exact bridge-max moments and integration over the entire observation collar bound the full local functional for every t in (0,.001].
Explicit C3 warping and C2 test caps retain the actual collar and its reflection. A global relative path bound and Gaussian tail include every auxiliary excursion; no disk transfer is inferred.
Poisson summation retains every half-integer thermal frequency. A complete nonzero-winding tail is included explicitly, including paths outside the collar.

The capped boundary parametrix is not the entire actual-domain heat remainder. Smooth interior and actual-disk propagation/comparison, including physical excursions, remain separate UNKNOWN estimates.

sources.use: Theorem 1.1, semibounded scalar Feynman-Kac formula on auxiliary capped extensions. No transfer to the actual bolt is assumed.

protocol.local_bound_rounding: Smallest positive integer strictly above the certified bound, at most 600.
